_comment: Single source of truth for install-fleet.sh. Edit here, not in the installer.

components.label: Workflow Gates
components.description: Fail-closed gate plugins (Nio, Nurikabe), workflow hook plugins, and the workflow state engine they exec/read. Cannot be split.
components.coupling: nio.js/nurikabe.js exec scripts/workflow-state.mjs at runtime; hook plugins read workflow state/state-path runtime helpers

components.label: Model Failover
components.description: Migawari plugin and the routing manifest it reads. Cannot be split.

components.label: Security Gate
components.description: Komainu plugin: screens Edit/Write calls for 35+ dangerous code patterns. Standalone.

components.label: Workflow Fleet (v2)
components.description: Full v2 workflow fleet (15 agents) as specified in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-30-opencode-harness-redesign-design.md. This scaffolding is retired in Part 7 when the npm package becomes the delivery mechanism.
components.coupling: soft dep on failover routing-manifest.json; auto-included at same scope if failover not selected there. opencode.jsonc ships with the bundle so fleet agent model mappings are installed by default; install-fleet.sh rewrites its 'plugin' and 'instructions' arrays against the current fleet manifest after copy. POST-COPY CONFIG MERGE IS MANDATORY: every scope where agents-core lands must run merge-config.mjs with --agents-source $FLEET_ROOT/opencode.jsonc, otherwise the installed opencode.jsonc will not be picked up by opencode and the fleet agents will inherit the user's previous model assignments (or none).

components.label: Agent Support Scripts
components.description: Verification and safety scripts called by agents via karakuri--command-runner (code runner). No hard coupling.

components.label: Rules
components.description: Memory contract and other rules loaded via instructions glob in opencode.json.
components.coupling: wired via instructions glob in opencode.json

components.label: Reference Docs
components.description: OPERATOR guide, architecture overview, manifest schema, agent template, model family guides, and shared GitHub workflow guide. Reference only, not required at runtime.
components.coupling: reference only; GITHUB.md and github-setup-check.sh sourced from repo-root docs/ and scripts/ at install time

components.label: Web Tools
components.description: Lean web-search/fetch/maps plugin with provider budgets and interactive config.
